svg.title: Gazebo plugin system internals
svg.desc: How Gazebo loads plugins and how gz_ros2_control bridges to ros2_control

g.text: every object is an Entity (integer ID)
properties are Components attached to entities
Joint entity has: pose, velocity, force components
Link entity has: inertia, collision, visual components
Sensor entity has: imu data component
for each declared joint: finds the Gazebo entity by name
stores entity IDs so it can read/write them each tick
Each sim step calls the plugin's update()
read joint state from ECS → fill StateInterfaces → run controllers → write CommandInterfaces → apply to ECS
